title: Austin Policy: Streets, Boards, New Financial Plan
summary:
*   **Future Policy Direction**: City leaders are preparing for an upcoming retreat to prioritize key policy issues submitted by Council members for future discussion and action.
*   **Street Improvement Funding**: Discussion is planned regarding the potential issuance of bonds to fund vital street improvements across the city.
*   **Government Accountability**: Proposals include annually eliminating inactive city boards and commissions, with the Mayor advocating for strict attendance requirements for committee members.
*   **Financial & Planning Overhaul**: A new "Overview Ordinance" is proposed to streamline the city's policy planning and financial management processes.

AUSTI

Austin City Council
MINUTES
For November 22, 1989 - POLICY PLANNING & BUDGET COMMITTEE MEETING Council Chambers, 307
West Second Street, Austin, Texas Councilmember Carl-Mitchell called to order the meeting
of the Policy Planning and Budget Committee, noting the presence of Mayor Cooke,
Councilmembers Nofziger and Barnstone. It was noted that draft issue papers had been
received from each member of the Council.
City Manager Camille Barnett discussed the Council Retreat to be held December 6, 1989 at
the Barton Creek Conference Center from 9:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. Dr. Barnett said the issue
papers will be discussed at the retreat and Council will decide in what order they should
be studied during future meetings and worksessions of the Council.
Councilmember Barnstone left the meeting at 3:29 P.M., so there was no longer a quorum.
Dr. Barnett went on to discuss plans for the coming year. She said she vouldlike
discussion of the issuance of bonds for street improvements. Dr.
Barnett said there should be vorksessions one full day each month and that the issues need
to be coordinated with the audit plan. She noted that there will be a City financial
discussion during the December 6, 1989 worksession.
Elaine Hart, Director of Financial Services, discussed a forecast assumptions meeting to
be held at the History Center and suggested speakers to invite to the meeting. Ms. Hart
then explained the proposed Overview Ordinance for policy planning and finance.
Mayor Cooke introduced a discussion concerning boards and commissions and said that
Council should probably sunset some of them. Dr. Barnett suggested that members of the
staff who work with boards and commissions should not make recommendations concerning them
but she was not certain, as yet, how or who should make the recommendations. Dr. Barnett
said that sunsetting should be done each year. Mayor Cooke said if four Councilmembers are
on a committee and "if they do not attend, then kick them off!". He said appointments to
Planning and Budget Committee and Audit and Finance Committee should be reaffirmed every
October.
The Committee adjourned its meeting at 4:15 Ρ.Μ. に
